note: Re-judged 2026-10-14 (independent auditor) after 56e67411be, where the authenticator's GetConfigForClient (eap_tls.go) answers every handshake negotiatesTLS13 classifies as TLS 1.2 with tls12WithoutTickets, so ze issues no TLS 1.2 ticket, while UnwrapSession redeemTLS13Only/refuseResumption (resumption.go) still refuses a TLS 1.2 session. Section 2.1.1 'If the session matches the peer's, then the ciphersuite MUST match' binds the resuming server. TestRFC5216ResumedFlightsCarryOnlyChangeCipherSpecAndFinished mints and resumes a TLS 1.2 session on a stock-resumption TEST server (stockTLS12Resumption) only to give the peer a live ticket encrypted under ze's own ticket keys; the suite-equality check there is a harness check on that test server and proves nothing about ze. The ze assertion is the last attempt, run with ze's unmodified authenticator config (tune nil): offered that ticket it does not resume and answers a full handshake (certificate, no change_cipher_spec). Ze therefore never matches a TLS 1.2 session, so no matched-session ciphersuite arises, and any TLS 1.2 resumption goes red. The test-server ticket does not weaken this: the subject of the assertion is ze's own authenticator and the input is the strongest one (a ticket ze's keys decrypt). Negative TestRFC5216TLSConfigRefusesWhatWouldBreakTheFlights: UnwrapSession answers no session at TLS 1.2 (on and off) and redeems at TLS 1.3, so the refusal is not vacuous.
